run_adsorbml_pipeline: run the AdsorbML pipeline for a given slab and adsorbate using a pretrained ML model
generate_adsorbate_slab_configurations: generate adsorbate-slab configurations using the ocp_adslab_generator function with a slab and adsorbate list
relax_atoms_structure: relax an atomic structure using the relax_job function with a calculator and optimizer
reference_adsorbate_slab_energies: reference adsorbate-slab energies to atomic and slab energies using the reference_adslab_energies function
detect_adsorbate_anomalies: detect anomalies like dissociation or desorption between initial and final atomic structures using detect_anomaly
